journey.name: M5 like and comment
journey.description: Signed in as journey.user, following journey.friend, whose post "Hello from a friend" has no likes or comments. Backend reachable.

actions.action: Verify that the feed shows the post "Hello from a friend" with "0 likes"
Tap the "Like" button on that post
Verify that the post shows "1 like" and an "Unlike" button
Enter "Nice shot!" in the "Add a comment…" field
Verify that the comment "Nice shot!" is shown by journey.user without "Sending…"
